fields.acceptance: A Go test in internal/api parses sample --log-failed output (a nested TestScripts/review-check-worktree failure, two failing tests in one package, and an infra-only log with no '--- FAIL:' line) into the expected test names and none for the infra log; a testscript with a fake gh whose check fails again after its rerun and whose 'run view 42 --log-failed' prints a '--- FAIL: TestScripts/x' line shows ship check --json listing that test as a failure and finding; run with go test -trimpath ./internal/api/... and go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/run-ship' only
fields.statement: When a PR head's checks still fail after their once-per-head rerun, rhiza ship check reads each failed Actions run's log (gh run view <run> --log-failed), reports the failing Go tests and testscripts it names ('--- FAIL: TestX[/sub]' lines) as test failures, and records each as a finding with no leaf for the next fix step; a failed check with no Actions run id, no parsable failing test, or only an infra/setup error stays a plain failure, as today

fields.acceptance: A Go test in internal/workflow loads the built-in ship-change workflow and asserts pr-green and rebased-green fail to ci-fix, ci-fix passes to render-pr with max_visits 2, the raised max_visits, and no on.fail on landed-green or rebased-merge-green; a testscript run-ship-ci-fix with a fake gh and a fake fixer agent goes red with a parsed test failure, through one ci-fix commit carrying a Review: trailer, back to green and signoff, and a second case red after two fixes fails the run with the failing tests in the step output, while an infra-only failure fails at pr-green with no ci-fix visit; run with go test -trimpath ./internal/workflow/... and go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/run-ship' only
fields.statement: The built-in ship-change workflow routes a test failure at pr-green or rebased-green to a ci-fix step: one fixer session on the run worktree, given the CI test findings appended to the review fixer's prompt and told to re-run only the failing tests and their packages, makes one new commit with a Review: <run> trailer, then the run goes on through render-pr, open-pr, wait-pr, pr-green and signoff; ci-fix runs at most twice per run (max_visits 2), max_visits on render-pr, open-pr, wait-pr, pr-green and signoff are raised so two CI fixes plus the owner's request-changes still fit, and landed-green and rebased-merge-green still fail the run as today
